actions.reading_en: Recording first contact, referral, diagnosis and treatment dates in the national quality register is what the 3.1.2 metric 'patients access treatment within the target times' needs before it can be computed, and what 3.2.2's county benchmarking and 4.1.3's live views of treatment start delays would read.
actions.gap_en: The roadmap does not list these four dates, the entry route, or quarterly county medians. Which timestamps the register holds is left to 3.1.4 and the register work in 3.2.1.
noRoadmapMeasureFor: quarterly publication of county-level medians (3.2.2 has annual peer reviews and publicly reported regional indicators, without a frequency for publication)

actions.reading_en: 3.1.2 writes cancer-specific national pathways on the Danish, Swedish and Norwegian models with target access times; 2.5.2 adds standardised referral criteria from primary care. Together they are this action.
actions.gap_en: SAMA's action text says 'maximum times per step'. The roadmap leaves the values to 3.1.2 (five cancers in 2026–2028); SAMA proposes no values of its own.

actions.reading_en: 2.5.2 describes 'direct test routes' and fast-access solutions from primary care, and 2.5.1 adds primary-care physician capacity. A same-week assessment with direct-access diagnostics in public health centres is one way to deliver both.
actions.gap_en: No measure targets the gap between public primary care and occupational or private care. The roadmap describes that gap only as background (pages 10-11).
noRoadmapMeasureFor: equalising access between public health centres and occupational or private care

actions.reading_en: 1.2.3 creates guidance for a named care-coordinating worker and first surveys in which phase of care and for which patient groups such a worker matters most. A navigator for stalled suspected-cancer work-ups is a candidate answer to that survey.
actions.gap_en: 1.2.3 describes coordination during treatment and rehabilitation. It does not name a navigator before diagnosis, nor a 90-day trigger. The INTERVENTIONS strategyMeasure field cites sub-objective 3.3; the closer roadmap measure is 1.2.3.
noRoadmapMeasureFor: a navigator for patients whose work-up has stalled before diagnosis

actions.reading_en: 2.3.4 names a lung cancer screening pilot that started in early 2026 in Helsinki and eight wellbeing services counties and is to expand regionally in 2026–2028. SAMA's action should therefore be framed as joining or extending that pilot, not starting a new one.
actions.gap_en: Which eight counties take part is not named in the roadmap. Targeting by county lung cancer mortality is SAMA's proposal, not the roadmap's.

actions.reading_en: HPV self-sampling for non-attenders fits 2.4.4's funded pilot studies within the screening programme and would serve the 2.4.1 metric of at least 80% participation in every programme and county. It is linked to 1.3.1 because a kit removes the language barrier of booking an appointment, and 1.3.1's metric is participation of people whose mother tongue is not Finnish or Swedish.
actions.gap_en: The roadmap does not mention HPV self-sampling. A search of the text for self-sampling terms found none.

actions.reading_en: Multilingual, plain-language re-invitations are what 1.3.1 funds, and its metric is that participation of people whose mother tongue is not Finnish or Swedish reaches the level of Finnish and Swedish speakers. The stepped pilot fits 2.4.4.
actions.gap_en: The roadmap names no colorectal reminder protocol and no second kit.
noRoadmapMeasureFor: a second colorectal screening kit for non-responders

actions.reading_en: 2.4.2 states that the screening decree's two-independent-radiologist requirement significantly hampers AI in breast screening, and schedules the legislative update. AI-supported single reading depends on that change. 3.5.3 funds limited AI pilots in some counties in 2026–2028.
actions.gap_en: The legislative update is scheduled for 2029–2031. Whether AI-supported single reading can run before then, for example as a pilot, was not checked. The INTERVENTIONS strategyMeasure field cites sub-objective 3.5 (personnel); the roadmap measure that names this barrier is 2.4.2.

actions.source: DATA_COLLECTION.md section 2 'Core four' and section 4 (the pathway scribe)
actions.reading_en: The proposal collects four patient-level events (FIRST_CONTACT, REFERRAL_SENT, DIAGNOSIS, TREATMENT_START) plus entry route, partly by reading dates from existing Finnish clinical text. 4.1.1 asks for structured cancer recording supported by AI-based methods; 3.2.1 targets 90% automated clinical notifications by 2030; 4.1.3 asks for live views of treatment start delays with a recording delay under one month.
actions.gap_en: In SAMA every extracted event is pre-filled for one-click confirmation and a person confirms it or marks it 'needs editing'. It therefore does not count as recording 'without manual data entry' in the 4.1.1 metric; it shortens manual entry. The scribe reads Finnish notes only.

thresholdRelabels.location: eventlog/aggregate.py aggregate(): thresholds=dict(primary_care=90, diagnostic=60, treatment=30, total=180); written to data/eventlog/county-intervals.json as threshold_days and share_within
thresholdRelabels.relabel_en: Placeholder threshold, not a national target time. Cancer-specific access times are to be defined under roadmap measure 3.1.2 (five cancers, 2026–2028, p. 57), and quality targets and indicators under 3.1.4 (at least the five largest cancer groups, 2026–2028, p. 58). Replace these values when they are published.

thresholdRelabels.location: src/recommend.mjs INTERVENTIONS navigation.action ('passes 90 days without a diagnosis') and PUBLIC_WORKUP.stallAfterDays = 90
thresholdRelabels.relabel_en: The 90-day trigger is a placeholder, not a national target time. It matches the population of the cited navigation evidence (ASSUMPTIONS.navigationHr: navigated patients already delayed over 90 days). Replace it with the access times that roadmap measures 3.1.2 and 3.1.4 define.

thresholdRelabels.location: src/recommend.mjs INTERVENTIONS timed-pathways.action ('maximum times per step')
thresholdRelabels.relabel_en: Maximum times per step are placeholders until roadmap measure 3.1.2 defines cancer-specific access times (five cancers, 2026–2028) and 3.1.4 sets the targets and indicators. SAMA proposes no values.

thresholdRelabels.location: src/analysis.mjs goal3 indicator 'treatment-within-target' and web/app.mjs 'Treatment within target times: not publicly measurable'
thresholdRelabels.relabel_en: The target times themselves are not yet defined nationally. Roadmap measure 3.1.2 schedules cancer-specific access times for five cancers in 2026–2028, and its metric is that patients access treatment within the target times.

2026–2028: Kansalliset hoitoketjukuvaukset tehty viidestä syövästä ja syöpäkohtaiset hoitoonpääsyajat on määritetty.

pilotCard.rationale_en: The coordinator chose Satakunta as the default pilot because its clinical notes are expected to be predominantly Finnish, which is the only language the scribe reads. That share was not measured in this repository.

snapshotEvidence.label: All cancers (C00-C97)
snapshotEvidence.display_en: Context, not a reason: age-standardised cancer mortality about 1.10 times the national level in the snapshot (shrunk estimate 1.097, 95% interval 1.063–1.132; 2021–2025). The two highest areas differ by 0.001 on the shrunk estimate, so no rank is claimed.

pilotCard.ask_en: Satakunta: a 2027 worklist pilot for every overdue suspected-cancer referral, lung follow-up first. The county owns the list; a nurse confirms each item and calls.

roadmapHooks.why_en: The worklist is the operational form of a named care-coordinating worker: the nurse who confirms and calls.
Every expansion of the national lung screening pilot creates follow-up loops that someone has to close.
Its 2026–2028 schedule starts piloting and deploying referral criteria in wellbeing services counties.
Its 2026–2028 schedule starts limited piloting of AI-based solutions in some wellbeing services counties.
AI-supported structured recording of cancer data; the pilot would report how much typing the pre-filled events save.
County benchmarking reads the same intervals the pilot would produce.

indicators_en: Share of imaging follow-ups done by the due date the radiologist wrote
Share of worklist items resolved within 14 days of appearing
Share of suspected-cancer referrals with a diagnosis recorded by the placeholder day
Each reported by entry route, education and contact language
Secondary: share of new cancer cases with the pathway dates recorded, and share of pre-filled events confirmed in one click or marked 'needs editing'
pilotCard.languageScope_en: The scribe reads Finnish notes only. Notes in Swedish, Sámi or any other language go to manual entry. The scribe, its training data and its tests are Finnish only.
pilotCard.humanReview_en: A person confirms every extracted event. Each event is pre-filled for one-click confirmation, or the person marks it 'needs editing' and corrects it.
pilotCard.dataNote_en: All patient-like data in SAMA are SYNTHETIC. The pilot has not been run.

earlierReadingCheck.note_en: Piloting and deployment in wellbeing services counties start in 2026–2028, after the criteria enter the pathways of at least the five most common cancers. The measure is on pages 52-53, outside the pages 55-61 the earlier reading cited.
